title: leave_organization confirm names neither the organisation nor what is lost: confirmText has no declared record scope for interpolation, and a host cannot override the platform bundle
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2910 (the organisation page: 邀请成员 primary, 退出组织 out of the primary slot and disabled for the last owner) cannot be done in cloud with what the spec declares. The os-dev on that card measured each gap with contract probes at framework `f7e836da` / objectui `ef71a09f` (report on cloud#2910). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectstack issue names record interpolation for `confirmText`.

## The gap
- The platform's `leave_organization.confirmText` reads 「Leave this organization? You will lose access to all of its resources.」 (`sys-organization.object.ts` L154; zh-CN in `platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` L581). It names neither the organisation nor what is lost.
- The spec declares no interpolation scope for `confirmText` (`action.zod.ts` L1334). `successMessage` declares only the result scope.
- A host cannot override the bundle: the framework's `sys_organization` translations load at `kernel:ready`, after cloud's (cloud `sys-organization.page.ts` L93–95).

## Done when
- `confirmText` gets a declared record scope.
- The platform copy names the organisation and what is lost: its environments and its members.
